Why the Python Requests Library Is Popular

The Python Requests library is one of the most widely used tools for making HTTP requests.

  • Ease of use: Simple functions like requests.get() and requests.post() make HTTP operations straightforward.
  • Readable code: Requests hides much of the complexity of lower-level networking libraries.
